paper_title: TARGET Benchmarking Table Retrieval for Generative Tasks
caption: Influence of k on retrieval performance with various baselines on the FeTaQA dataset, confirming the expectation that performance gradually increases with k, most significantly for dense embedding approaches.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The graph illustrates the relationship between the variable 'k' and 'recall' across different methods, showcasing how recall changes as 'k' increases. The X-axis is labeled 'k', has a linear scale, and ranges from 0 to 40, with numerical labels at intervals of 20, specifically at 0, 20, and 40. The Y-axis is labeled 'recall', also has a linear scale, and spans from 0.0 to 0.8, with numerical labels at intervals of 0.2, specifically at 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8. 

There are five distinct lines in the graph, each representing a different method. The 'sparse lexical repr. (w/ title)' is represented by a grey dashed line with no markers, while 'sparse lexical repr. (w/o title)' is depicted by a purple dashed line, also without markers. 'Dense metadata emb.' is shown as a green dashed line with circle markers. 'Dense table emb.' is illustrated by a blue solid line with circle markers, and 'dense table emb. (col names only)' is represented by a red dashed line with circle markers. Lastly, 'dense row emb.' is shown as a dark blue solid line with circle markers. 

The 'sparse lexical repr. (w/ title)' line starts at approximately 0.05 on the Y-axis when 'k' is 0 and increases to around 0.23 when 'k' is 40. The 'sparse lexical repr. (w/o title)' line begins at roughly 0.03 when 'k' is 0 and rises to about 0.2 when 'k' is 40. The 'dense metadata emb.' line commences at approximately 0.3 when 'k' is 0 and reaches around 0.62 when 'k' is 40. The 'dense table emb.' line starts at roughly 0.45 when 'k' is 0 and increases to about 0.86 when 'k' is 40. The 'dense table emb. (col names only)' line begins at approximately 0.1 when 'k' is 0 and rises to around 0.42 when 'k' is 40. The 'dense row emb.' line starts at roughly 0.5 when 'k' is 0 and reaches about 0.88 when 'k' is 40. All lines generally exhibit an upward trend as 'k' increases from 0 to 40.
model_annotations.Chinese: 该图展示了在FeTaQA数据集上不同检索方法在变化的k值下的召回率比较。x轴标记为“k”，具有线性刻度，范围从0到40，数值刻度间隔为20。y轴标记为“召回率”，具有线性刻度，范围从0.0到0.8，数值刻度间隔为0.2。该图包含五条线，每条线代表一种不同的检索方法。“稀疏词汇表示（带标题）”和“稀疏词汇表示（不带标题）”分别用灰色和紫色虚线表示，而“稠密元数据嵌入”、“稠密表格嵌入”和“稠密行嵌入”分别用绿色、蓝色和海军蓝实线表示。稀疏词汇表示在x轴上从0到50的召回率相对较低且相对稳定，分别约为0.05和0.2。“稠密元数据嵌入”从（0，0.34）开始，到（50，0.6）结束。“稠密表格嵌入（仅列名）”从（2，0.1）增加到（50，0.4）。“稠密表格嵌入”和“稠密行嵌入”分别从（2，0.53）和（2，0.57）开始，到（50，0.86）和（50，0.87）结束。
model_annotations.German: The diagram illustrates the relationship between the recall and the value of k for various embedding approaches on the FeTaQA dataset. The x-axis is labeled 'k' and ranges from 0 to 40 with tick labels at 0, 20, and 40, while the y-axis is labeled 'recall' and spans from 0.0 to 0.8 with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The diagram features five lines representing different embedding methods: sparse lexical representation with title (grey, dashed), sparse lexical representation without title (purple, dash-dotted), dense metadata embedding (green, dashed), dense table embedding (blue, solid), dense table embedding with column names only (red, dashed), and dense row embedding (navy, solid). The grey line is mostly obscured by other lines. The purple line starts at approximately (0, 0.03) and increases to around (50, 0.23). The green line begins at roughly (0, 0.25) and rises to about (50, 0.61). The blue line commences at approximately (0, 0.44) and reaches around (50, 0.86). The red line starts at roughly (0, 0.08) and ascends to approximately (50, 0.42). The navy line begins at around (0, 0.47) and increases to about (50, 0.87), closely following the blue line. All lines exhibit an upward trend as k increases.
